title: Go executor refuses the factory's Workers AI step-down of a rung dispatch
body:
When no subscription is free, the door boots the deployment's standing pair and returns pi-durable / workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3. cloudflaresandbox.Executor.Start refuses any handle whose model is not the requested one ('sonnet'), so the [A1] fallback can never start a worker. CloudRule.SubscriptionRungs[].Fallback is read only by a test, and it is spelled cloudflare-workers-ai/... while the factory steps down to RUN_WORKER_MODEL (workers-ai/...). Fix: when the request is a subscription-rung pair, accept exactly the rung's declared fallback pair (namespace-normalised), record the pair that ran, and test that both sides agree.
evidence: internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox/executor.go:445; repro: newExecutorOnRung(claude, sonnet) with door.bootedModel=workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3, bootedHarness=pi-durable -> 'the door booted attempt 1 ... on model "workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3", not the "sonnet" its dispatch resolved'
